summary: A plain light canvas (#fdfdfd) built like an AI chat transcript. A near-black pill message bubble (#101010, fully rounded, about 383x85 px) sits top-right at x 607–990, y 108–193 and reads "Get us live in Sweden." in white sans (~28 px). It blurs and fades in between 0.3 s and 0.7 s. Under it, a left-aligned agent log starts at x 104 (icons) and x 149 (text), top row at y 283. From about 1.5 s a spinner and a shimmering grey "Start thinking…" header with a running seconds counter appear. Below them, grey reasoning text (~26 px, 44 px line height) streams in word by word with a blur fade. The text scrolls upward behind a top fade mask: two paragraphs, then the numbered list "1. Read Swedish order history … 5. Write the launch report", then "Orders first. They set the baseline for everything else." At about 6 s the whole thinking block blurs away and the header rolls from "Start thinking…" to "Working", led by a chevron. A thin grey vertical timeline at x 115 then grows down the left as steps arrive in 63 px rows, each with a spinner that turns into a grey dot when it finishes. The steps are: "Done thinking"; "Reading → Read 🛍 Shopify Swedish orders" with a bordered, rounded two-row subtask card (spinners become black check discs); "Start searching N sources → Searched 46 sources" with grey chips (acedesign.io, LinkedIn – Ace Design Io…, X – Ace Design Io News, AI Search, 20+ more); "Delegating to Brand Researcher" with a second subtask card; "Preparing the report" with a file-preview card labelled "sweden-insight PDF" and a blue cursor. That card collapses to "Report is ready 📄 Sweden Insight", and "Finished working" with a blue check disc blurs in at about 28.5 s. The bubble never moves. All motion is appearance in place: blur and fade, spinner rotation, counter ticks, and rows pushing content down.

criteria.check: Background is a flat near-white (#fdfdfd) with no gradient or texture
At 0.2s the frame is empty: no bubble or text is visible
Pill spans x≈607–990, y≈108–193 (right edge 90px from the frame edge)
Pill fill is near-black (#101010) with fully rounded ends (radius ≈ half the height)
Pill reads exactly 'Get us live in Sweden.' in white regular sans, ~28px
Pill fades/blurs in: absent at 0.2s, sharp and fully dark by 0.7s, with ≤3px vertical settle and no horizontal slide
Pill does not move or change after 0.7s (same box at 9.3s and 28.5s)
During thinking the header icon is a thin dark ring spinner (~22px) with a gap, left at x≈104, centred y≈283
Header reads 'Start thinking...' followed by a lighter seconds counter ('1s')
Header text starts at x≈149, baseline row centred at y≈283, about 90px below the pill bottom
'Start thinking...' has a moving shimmer: part of the word is darker than the rest (e.g. 'inking' darker at 2.9s)
First reasoning line reads 'The goal is to get the store live in Sweden. Start with what' in light grey, ~26px, starting x≈149
Text streams in word by word: newest words at the end of the line are blurred and faint, and between 2.4s and 2.9s 'from Sweden today, what they buy, and how often they' is added

Numbered list shows 5 items: 'Read Swedish order history', 'Search local market sources', 'Brief the Brand Researcher', 'Compare Sweden against Norway', 'Write the launch report' with small monospace-like numerals '1.'–'5.'
Closing line reads 'Orders first. They set the baseline for everything else.'
The text block scrolls upward as it grows: at 4.9s earlier lines fade out under the header (top mask) and 'Then look outward…' sits at y≈391
Between 6.05s and 6.55s the whole thinking text blurs out heavily in place (no slide)
Header label changes from 'Start thinking...' to 'Working' with a vertical blurred roll, the counter moving left to sit after 'Working'
After the switch the header icon is a thin grey down-chevron at x≈104–126
Header counter ticks up once per second: about '8s' at 9.3s and '27s' at 28.5s
A thin light-grey vertical line at x≈115 joins the header chevron to each step's dot
Row reads 'Done thinking' in grey with a small light-grey dot at x≈115, y≈346
Step rows are evenly spaced about 63px apart: Working y≈283, Done thinking y≈346, Read y≈409, Searched y≈472
Row reads 'Reading' (grey) then a green Shopify bag icon and 'Shopify Swedish orders' in darker, semi-bold text
Shopify icon is a small green shopping bag with a white 'S', drawn as an original ~20px icon
Subtask card is white with a 1px very light grey border, corner radius ≈22px, spanning x≈138–989, and split into 2 rows by a hairline at y≈527
Card rows read 'Pulling Swedish order history' and 'Spotting top sellers in Sweden', each led by a ring spinner at x≈182
Row 1 changes to a black check disc with 'Pulled Swedish order history' (~10s), then row 2 to 'Spotted top sellers in Sweden' (~11s)
After both checks the card blurs out and the row text changes from 'Reading' to 'Read' with a grey dot (~12s)
Search row's count climbs ('Start searching 3 sources' → '46 sources') while chips pop in one by one, then the label becomes 'Searched  46 sources'
Exactly 4 grey chips in 2 rows (2 + 2) followed by plain text '20+ more'
Chips read 'acedesign.io', 'LinkedIn - Ace Design Io...', 'X - Ace Design Io News', 'AI Search'
Chips are light grey (#ececec) with ~10px radius, ~48px tall and dark text; '20+ more' has no chip background
Each chip has an original favicon: a lime square with a black half-circle mark, a blue LinkedIn 'in', a black X, and a multicolour Google 'G'
Row at y≈665 reads 'Delegating to' (grey), a green faceted gem avatar, then 'Brand Researcher' in darker semi-bold
Second card rows read 'Scanned Swedish competitor brands' (black check, dark text) and 'Mapping local pricing trends' (spinner, grey text)
Second card's spinners become checks in order ('Scanned' first, then 'Mapped'), and the card then disappears so 'Preparing the report' sits directly below the Delegating row
File card is a light grey rounded (~22px) box ≈361x271 at x≈139, y≈764 holding a white page preview with a grey skeleton line
Card footer reads 'sweden-insight', with a small outlined 'PDF' pill tag on the right
A small blue arrow cursor is drawn on the page preview
Report row reads 'Report is ready' then a blue document icon and 'Sweden Insight' in darker semi-bold, with a grey dot
By 28.5s the file card is gone and no card remains below 'Report is ready'
Last row 'Finished working' has a blue filled check disc at x≈115 and fades in with a blur at y≈794
The active step shows a rotating ring spinner that turns into a small grey dot once the step is complete (e.g. the Delegating row at 20.5s vs 24s)
All log text is left-aligned at x≈149, and subtask cards' right edge lines up with the pill's right edge (x≈990)
Verb labels ('Done thinking', 'Read', 'Searched') are mid grey (~#7a7a7a), while object names ('Shopify Swedish orders', 'Brand Researcher') are darker and heavier
